title: Alphabet
summary: AL'PHABET, noun [Gr.] The letters of a language arranged in the customary order; the series of letters which form the elements of speech. AL'PHABET, verb transitive To arrange in the order of an alpha

inlines.v: AL'PHABET, noun [Gr.] The letters of a language arranged in the customary order; the series of letters which form the elements of speech. AL'PHABET, verb transitive To arrange in the order of an alphabet; to form an alphabet in a book, or designate the leaves by the letters of the alphabet
